title: Conveyancing Paralegal
description:
Paralegal - Residential Conveyancing
- Annual Salary: £26,000 - £32,000
- Location: Farnham, UK
- Job Type: Full-time

Join a dynamic and growing Residential Conveyancing team in Farnham as a full-time Paralegal. This role offers the chance to work closely with experienced lawyers, supporting a diverse caseload across various matters. It's an excellent opportunity for career growth, offering a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Support experienced lawyers by managing a caseload of Residential Conveyancing matters.
- Perform a full range of administrative duties including managing calls, responding to enquiries, and providing updates to clients, estate agents, lenders, and solicitors.
- Handle file opening procedures ensuring compliance, draft contract packs, and manage post-exchange administration including preparing COTS, conducting final searches, lodging SDLT, and AP1.
- Deal with Land Registry requisitions and occasionally perform dictation tasks.
- Maintain high standards of client care, ensuring effective communication and updates.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Proven experience as a Paralegal in the legal sector, preferably within Residential Conveyancing.
- Familiarity with Conveyancing processes and procedures.
- Experience with Tikit Partner for Windows is advantageous.
- Excellent client care skills with a commitment to delivering high-quality service.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to multitask, set priorities, and manage time effectively.
- Proficiency in modern IT systems, both audio and copy typing, and diary management.
- Attention to detail and a strong commitment to confidentiality.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary.
- 25 days annual leave plus Bank Holidays.
- Offices closed between Christmas and New Year with paid leave in addition to annual leave.
- Hybrid working options.
- Salary sacrifice pension scheme with a matching 5% contribution.
- Life assurance and Group Income Protection scheme.
- BUPA cashback plan and Private Medical Insurance.
- Enhanced Family Friendly policies.
- Employee Assistance Programmes including a GP Consultation service.
- Funded professional subscription fees and support towards professional qualifications.
- Employee Referral Scheme and Volunteering programme.
- Car Parking Season Ticket Loan.
- A range of social events including a summer and Christmas party.

To apply for this Paralegal position in Residential Conveyancing, please submit your CV and cover letter detailing your relevant experience and why you are interested in this role to Mark Watts at Reed, your "very friendly" local legal recruitment specialist!

title: HR Administrator
description:
HR Administrator

Farnham Temporary role ongoing

Are you an organised and proactive HR professional looking for a varied, hands-on role within a busy HR team?

Our client is seeking an HR Administrator to join their team in Farnham on a temporary basis for approximately three months. This role will focus on providing day-to-day HR administrative support, assisting with recruitment activities and responding to general employee queries.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous HR administration experience who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, has strong attention to detail and is confident supporting a range of HR processes.

The Role

As HR Administrator, you will provide essential administrative support across the HR function, helping to ensure the smooth running of day-to-day activities.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Supporting recruitment administration, including arranging interviews, liaising with candidates and preparing offer documentation
- Coordinating onboarding and induction processes for new starters
- Preparing employment contracts, offer letters and other HR documentation
- Responding to general HR queries from employees and managers
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date employee records and HR systems
- Supporting the administration of holidays, sickness absence and other employee changes
- Assisting with the preparation and maintenance of HR policies, procedures and employee documentation
- Ensuring personnel files and HR records are organised and compliant with data protection requirements
- Providing general administrative support to the HR function as required

About You
- Previous experience in an HR administration or HR support role
- Good organisational skills and strong attention to detail
- Confident communication skills with a professional and approachable manner
- Comfortable handling confidential information
- Good IT skills, including experience using Microsoft Office and HR systems
- Able to manage competing priorities and work effectively in a busy environment
- A proactive, flexible approach and willingness to support the wider HR team

If you have previous HR administration experience and are available for a temporary assignment, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Legal Secretary
description:
Private Client Legal Secretary

Location: Farnham - no parking

An excellent opportunity has arisen for an experienced Legal Secretary to join a busy and well-established Private Client team based in Farnham. This role offers the chance to provide essential secretarial and administrative support to a team of legal professionals handling a varied caseload of Private Client matters.

This is an ideal position for someone who thrives in a fast-paced legal environment, enjoys delivering exceptional client service, and takes pride in providing accurate and efficient administrative support.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide comprehensive secretarial support to the Private Client team.
- Prepare, format, and amend legal documents and correspondence.
- Audio and copy typing with a high level of accuracy.
- Manage diaries, appointments, and meeting arrangements.
- Handle client enquiries professionally and efficiently.
- Maintain electronic and paper filing systems.
- Assist with general administrative duties to support the department.
- Ensure all work is completed accurately and within required timescales.

About You

The successful candidate will have:
- Previous experience as a Legal Secretary within Private Client, or experience in another legal practice area.
- Excellent organisational and time management skills.
- Strong audio and copy typing abilities.
- Outstanding communication and client care skills.
- A proactive and positive approach to work.
- Good IT skills and confidence using modern legal case management systems.
- Experience with Tikit (Partner for Windows/PW4) would be advantageous but is not essential.
- The ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team.

What's on Offer
- Competitive salary.
- Full-time, permanent position.
- Supportive and friendly working environment.
- Career development and progression opportunities.
- Opportunity to join a growing and successful legal team.

If you're an organised Legal Secretary looking for your next opportunity within a respected Private Client team, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Part-Time Office Manager / Facilities Coordinator

Interested?
